tldr: The Moon in Virgo: emotions seek order, usefulness, and practical repair.
body: With the Moon in Virgo, feelings often move through analysis, service, and the desire to make things better. Emotional safety grows when the nervous system has rhythm, clarity, and something manageable to tend.
gift: Discernment, helpfulness, emotional precision, and the ability to improve daily life.
challenge: Anxiety, criticism, and trying to fix feelings instead of letting them exist.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-sign material.
